parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit corrects all three error targets: it removes the false claim that naming the variations constitutes full grounding, rejects the unsupported inference that authors can easily identify the referenced part, and avoids assigning a numeric score or gold label. The specificity assessment (that the comment clearly identifies what needs to be addressed regarding biological plausibility) is preserved. The corrected rationale is coherent, does not invent evidence, and does not state a numeric final score.
